entities.name: Non-Access Stratum
entities.description: The highest stratum of the control plane between UE and MME at the radio interface, supporting mobility management and session management procedures.

entities.name: EPS Mobility Management
entities.description: Elementary procedures for EPS mobility management, supporting UE mobility functions.

entities.name: EPS Session Management
entities.description: Elementary procedures for EPS session management, establishing and maintaining IP connectivity between UE and PDN GW.

entities.name: NAS Security
entities.description: Provides integrity protection and ciphering of NAS signalling messages, handled as part of EPS mobility management.

entities.name: Attach Procedure
entities.description: Links mobility management and session management procedures to provide ready-to-use IP connectivity.

entities.name: NAS Signalling Connection
entities.description: Established connection enabling activation of ciphering and integrity protection for NAS security.

relations.description: NAS includes EPS mobility management procedures as part of its functions.
NAS includes EPS session management procedures to establish and maintain IP connectivity.
NAS security is an additional function providing integrity protection and ciphering.
